# Papercuts — evidence-intake-project

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-08-09 [codex] The first GUI smoke screenshot used CopyFromScreen on the WinSafe window bounds, but another terminal occluded those bounds and the saved image showed the covering window; foreground the target or use PrintWindow for reliable native UI capture.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.the-first-gui-smoke-screenshot-used/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] The AGENTS protocol names commands as knowledge.context, but this PowerShell environment only exposes the akr executable; the first required context call failed until translated to 'akr context'.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.the-agents-protocol-names-commands-as-knowledge/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] 'akr propose --from' help says a file holding the record body but does not show the required parseable wrapper; passing plain prose failed with AKR-C031 instead of identifying the expected body grammar.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.akr-propose-from-help-says-a-file-holding-the/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] Adding the evidence-gui binary made the README's existing 'cargo run -- ...' commands ambiguous; the smoke-test seed failed until the package declared evidence as default-run.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.adding-the-evidence-gui-binary-made-the-readme/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] A recursive API scan used the common Unix-style 'rg ... src/*.rs' form, but PowerShell passed the glob literally and ripgrep rejected it; use 'rg ... src -g *.rs' on this Windows workspace.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.a-recursive-api-scan-used-the-common-unix-style/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] A final ripgrep line-number lookup embedded a double-quoted regex inside a double-quoted PowerShell command, so the quotes were consumed and rg reported an unclosed group; single-quote regex literals in PowerShell.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.a-final-ripgrep-line-number-lookup-embedded-a/1`

## Not about this project

Frictions with something else — a tool, a harness — hit while working here. They are logged where they were hit; `akr papercut collate --about <subject>` is how the project that owns the subject gathers them.

- 2026-08-10 [claude] (akr) knowledge.propose returns lock_stale:true on every write but does not refresh akr.lock, so a later knowledge.validate fails with AKR-R052 ("akr.lock has no hash for <the record I just wrote>"). The fix is `akr lock --update`, but nothing in the propose result or the diagnostic says so, and AGENTS.md's "never hand-edit .akr/" made me hesitant to touch the lock at all. Suggest either refreshing the lock as part of propose, or having AKR-R052 name `akr lock --update` as the remedy.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.knowledge-propose-returns-lock-stale-true-on/1`
- 2026-08-10 [claude] (akr) knowledge.explain crashed with AKR-X099 (internal) for both `decision` and `constraint` after knowledge.propose rejected my slots with AKR-T002. The propose error names the bad slot but not the valid ones, and explain -- the documented way to find them -- is exactly what fails, so I had to read .akr/records/*.akr by hand to learn that a decision uses `decision` plus `claim` blocks and has no `rationale` or `note` slot. Suggest AKR-T002 list the kind's valid slots inline.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.knowledge-explain-crashed-with-akr-x099/1`
- 2026-08-10 [claude] (akr) I passed scope terms as "path src/gui/winsafe.rs" to knowledge.propose, copying the `path "..."` form the generated views render, and it was accepted silently — producing scope `path "path src/gui/winsafe.rs"`, a glob that can never match a file, so the records would never have gone stale when winsafe.rs changed. Nothing validates that a scope glob is well-formed or warns that it currently matches zero paths. A warning when a path term matches nothing in the worktree would have caught this at propose time instead of three records later.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.i-passed-scope-terms-as-path-src-gui-winsafe-rs/1`
- 2026-08-09 [claude] (akr) Ran knowledge.context --goal on a project whose ledger held only the namespace stub in project.akr; it failed with AKR-X001 "does not resolve to a record" rather than saying the ledger is empty. On a fresh project that reads as a broken tool call. A distinct message ("no records yet; start with knowledge.propose") would tell an agent to author the first record instead of retrying with different goal strings.  `@evidence-intake-project.papercut.ran-knowledge-context-goal-on-a-project-whose/1`
